answer.report_md:
## 画出来要什么
一张无编号的分组柱状图：标题 **"LockBit vs. RANSOMHUB DLS Listings, 2024"** 置于图上方，左侧竖排轴标题 "Count of DLS Listings"，y 轴刻度 0/50/100/150/200，仅有水平网格线。x 轴 12 个月份槽（Jan…Dec，注意 "March"、"April"、"Sept" 混用长短写），每槽两根柱（黑=LockBit，蓝=RANSOMHUB），共 24 根，无数值标签。图例画在绘图区内部右上角。页面左侧另有一列窄栏文字（"Data leak sites (DLS) are websites…"）与图并排，正文含上标脚注 "UNC2165¹⁸"。

## 定位一个值难在哪
以 175 为例：它是 May 的黑色 LockBit 柱，柱顶落在 150 与 200 刻度之间、无印数。刻度间距 50，5% 容差只有 ±8.75 像素级别，读者只能目测插值；且必须同时给出 "May"+"LockBit" 两个标签，图无编号，表格行难以与图关联。10 与 55 各出现两次（Jan/Feb 蓝柱；March 黑柱与 Dec 蓝柱），仅凭数字无法唯一定位。

## 不确定的
所有数值均为轴读估计，无源注、无数据链接；图例颜色与系列名的对应靠色块判断；"55" 究竟指 March LockBit 还是 Dec RANSOMHUB 无法确定。

axes.serves: all bars, both LockBit and RANSOMHUB
the 12 month slots of paired bars

worked_example.why_hard: Bar top lies between the 150 and 200 gridlines; no printed label, 50-unit tick spacing.

components.evidence: two bars side by side in each month slot, black and blue
LockBit / RANSOMHUB legend box drawn over upper-right of plot area
"Count of DLS Listings" set vertically along the left axis
axis ticks read 0, 50, 100, 150, 200; scale word only in "Count of DLS Listings"
horizontal rules at 50/100/150/200 across panel, no vertical rules
narrow left column "Data leak sites (DLS) are websites that publish stolen data..." beside the figure band

new_components.name: unnumbered_figure_title
new_components.evidence: bold title "LockBit vs. RANSOMHUB DLS Listings, 2024" with no "Figure n" prefix anywhere

new_components.name: inconsistent_month_abbreviations
new_components.evidence: axis reads Jan, Feb, March, April, May, June, July, Aug, Sept, Oct, Nov, Dec

spot_checks.mark: the Jan LockBit (black) bar, just above 50
the Jan RANSOMHUB (blue) bar, or equally the Feb blue bar
the Feb LockBit (black) bar, reaching the 100 gridline
the March LockBit (black) bar, slightly above 50
the May LockBit (black) bar, the tallest on the chart
the June RANSOMHUB (blue) bar, between 0 and 50
the Aug RANSOMHUB (blue) bar, between 50 and 100
the Nov RANSOMHUB (blue) bar, just under 100
the Dec RANSOMHUB (blue) bar, just above 50 (same reading as March LockBit)

answer.hardest_step_why: 刻度间隔50且无数值标签，175、68、82 需目测插值，5%容差仅±3.4至±8.75，读数极易超差。

examples.quote: Bold line "LockBit vs. RANSOMHUB DLS Listings, 2024" above the plot, with no "Figure" number anywhere
examples.why: 标题无编号、单位另置于竖排轴标题，需把编号/标题/单位/位置拆成独立字段。

examples.quote: y axis ticks read 0, 50, 100, 150, 200; no number is printed on any of the 24 bars
examples.why: 24根柱全靠轴读，可达精度随刻度间距变化，应按标记给出精度而非布尔可读。

examples.quote: Legend box "LockBit / RANSOMHUB" drawn inside the plot area at upper right
examples.why: 图例置于绘图区内部、竖排轴标题、值标签全缺，这些样式维度当前不可控。

examples.quote: Left column text "Data leak sites (DLS) are websites that publish stolen data..." runs level with the plot
examples.why: 需支持图与旁栏文字共占一横带的整页版式；当前只生成孤立图。
